bio.text: Bill Reeside is the Libertarian candidate for South Carolina's 1st Congressional District in 2026; WCSC reported that he will not have a primary.
He is a retired nuclear engineer who spent decades working on nuclear power plants, and WCSC reported that he does not have direct experience in politics.
In the 1990s he was sent to North Korea in connection with a commercial nuclear power project, according to his account to WCSC.

sources.title: WE THE PALMETTO: Meet the Candidate: Bill Reeside (For SC-01)
